sources.title: PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement
sources.facts: Only denoised features propagate across scales; DINO-modulated outputs feed final fusion. One frozen multidepth encoder call supplies spatial prompts. Neighborhood embeddings precede prompting.
sources.scope: Low-light RGB enhancement, not our independently measured sensor-linear 16-bit JDD.
sources.local_inference: A future feature-fusion comparison should distinguish the measurement-driven denoising stream from semantic modulation and preserve native coordinates. Current V157 is an independent RGB-residual architecture, not this paper.

sources.title: Structural Guidance for Unified Joint Demosaicing and Denoising
sections: Online Structural Prior Adaptation and Fusion
sources.facts: Final fusion convolution is zero initialized and trainable. The nominal pseudo-RGB input stem remains zero in the reported state because the detached encoder prevents its gradients. Adapter/fusion sit outside the frozen encoder call.
sources.scope: Paper uses resized224 structural input and decoded-sRGB Gaussian observations; these do not validate native sensor-linear physical-noise quality.
sources.local_inference: Any new trainable input adapter must demonstrate an actual gradient path; freezing encoder parameters and enclosing input-dependent computation in no_grad differ. Feature adapters can train outside the frozen call.

scope: Method review during the original fixed V157 run. No retuning or quality inference from external reported results.
